extraction.name: LongVid
extraction.description: A large-scale long video instruction-tuning dataset comprising 114,228 long videos and 3,444,849 question-answering (QA) pairs across five different task types.
extraction.creator: Xinhao Li, Yi Wang, Jiashuo Yu, Xiangyu Zeng, Yuhan Zhu, Haian Huang, Jianfei Gao, Kunchang Li, Yinan He, Chenting Wang, Yu Qiao, Yali Wang, Limin Wang
extraction.rai:dataCollection: The dataset was built by leveraging existing video datasets, generating dense event labels using existing short video captions, filtering consecutive segments to regroup into long video sequences, and constructing QA pairs based on captions, event labels, and timestamps.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: Existing video datasets including Ego4D, HowTo100M, HD-VILA, and MiraData.
extraction.rai:dataManipulationProtocol: For data curation, the authors utilized existing high-quality short video captions and filtered consecutive segments that could be regrouped into a long video sequence. They constructed a sequence of event labels with corresponding timestamps for every long video based on their captions. For datasets without high-quality event-level annotations, they extracted the major event from the caption using an LLM. Finally, they constructed several types of long video QA pairs based on the video captions, event labels, and the timestamps of short video segments.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Filtering consecutive short video segments to regroup them into long video sequences.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Dense event labels were generated using existing high-quality short video captions. For datasets with existing event-level annotations, they were used directly; for others, an LLM extracted the major event from the caption. Finally, several types of long video QA pairs were constructed based on the video captions, event labels, and timestamps.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Instruction tuning and joint short & long video training for multimodal large language models.
